en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Hassan Bin Sayf, from his brother, from his father, from Abu Hamza, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>
regarding the Words of the Exalted
[51:8] Most surely you are at variance with each other in what you say
regarding the matter of Al-Wilayah [51:9] He is turned away from it who would be turned away. Heasws said: ‘The one who turns away from Al-Wilayah, turns away from the Paradise’.
en.sarwar: 48. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Jumhur from Yunus who has said the following “A person in a marfu‘ narrated to me from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.)
about the words of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Gracious.
“Yet, he has not entered into Aqaba [90:11]. Would that you knew what Aqaba is! [90:12]. It is the setting free of a slave.” [90:13]
The Imam (a.s.) said, “Setting free of a slave is acknowledgment of the Wilaya of Amir al-Mu’minin (a.s.), Leadership with Divine Authority.”
